external_product_id,external_variant_id,title,sku,currency,price,available,market_id
prism-import-01,prism-import-v1,棱镜桌灯 · CSV 样品,PRISM-IMPORT-21,CNY,129.00,true,b255f75c-45df-44de-bf54-b792050c5329
